definitions.explanation: A machine that produces paper copies of documents or images. Common in offices, convenience stores, schools, and public libraries in Japan. Modern devices usually combine copying, printing, scanning, and faxing functions.

examples.japanese: コピー{機|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧コピー{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used the copier at the convenience store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コピー{機|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五十部|ごじゅうぶ}⟦{印刷|いんさつ}した→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I printed fifty copies of the materials on the company copier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コピー{機|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スキャナー→スキャナー：05248_sukyanaa⟧やファックス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: Recent copiers also come with scanner and fax functions.

notes:
Formed from ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧ (copy, from English) + ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine, device). A general term covering everything from small desktop units to large multifunction office devices.

USAGE:
- In offices, コピー{機|き} most often refers to a large multifunction device (⟦{複合機|ふくごうき}→複合機：16525_fukugouki⟧) that also prints, scans, and sends faxes.
- At Japanese convenience stores, a コピー{機|き} also serves as a service terminal for printing documents, official forms, and tickets.
- Billed by the page; most convenience store copiers charge around 10⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ per black-and-white page.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コピー{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use the copier
- コピー{機|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}する→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧: the copier breaks down
- コピー{機|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧: to print on the copier
- コピー{機|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: the paper jams in the copier
- ⟦{両面|りょうめん}→両面：11366_ryoumen⟧⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧: double-sided copy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{複合機|ふくごうき}→複合機：16525_fukugouki⟧: multifunction device — technical term for a copier/printer/scanner/fax combo
- ⟦プリンター→プリンター：04416_purintaa⟧: printer — focuses on printing from a computer
- コピー{機|き} vs ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧{器|き}: both written forms appear, but ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ is the standard form for a machine
